    <title>op-proposer v1.16.5</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Overview</h2>
<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-important"><p class="markdown-alert-title"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-report mr-2" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 1.75C0 .784.784 0 1.75 0h12.5C15.216 0 16 .784 16 1.75v9.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.25 13H8.06l-2.573 2.573A1.458 1.458 0 0 1 3 14.543V13H1.75A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 0 11.25Zm1.75-.25a.25.25 0 0 0-.25.25v9.5c0 .138.112.25.25.25h2a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.19l2.72-2.72a.749.749 0 0 1 .53-.22h6.5a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-9.5a.25.25 0 0 0-.25-.25Zm7 2.25v2.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.5 0v-2.5a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0ZM9 9a1 1 0 1 1-2 0 1 1 0 0 1 2 0Z"></path></svg>Important</p><p>This is a recommended release for all op-proposer operators. It contains dependency and container base image updates that clear reported CVEs, with no behaviour changes.</p>
</div>
<h2>What's Changed</h2>
<h3>Security</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>golang.org/x/crypto</code> updated to 0.56.0, clearing <code>CVE-2026-56855</code> and <code>CVE-2026-78662</code>. Both are denial-of-service issues in <code>golang.org/x/crypto/ssh</code>, which op-proposer does not link — the upgrade clears the reported findings rather than closing a reachable path (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5332928057" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22750" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22750/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22750">#22750</a>)</li>
<li>The container image now ships zlib 1.3.2-r7, clearing <code>CVE-2026-85091</code></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full Changelog</strong>: <a class="commit-link" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/compare/op-proposer/v1.16.4...op-proposer/v1.16.5"><tt>op-proposer/v1.16.4...op-proposer/v1.16.5</tt></a></p>

</ul>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/238797860/op-challenger/v1.9.6</id>
    <updated>2026-09-15T16:46:27Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases/tag/op-challenger%2Fv1.9.6"/>
    <title>op-challenger v1.9.6</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Overview</h2>
<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-important"><p class="markdown-alert-title"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-report mr-2" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 1.75C0 .784.784 0 1.75 0h12.5C15.216 0 16 .784 16 1.75v9.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.25 13H8.06l-2.573 2.573A1.458 1.458 0 0 1 3 14.543V13H1.75A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 0 11.25Zm1.75-.25a.25.25 0 0 0-.25.25v9.5c0 .138.112.25.25.25h2a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.19l2.72-2.72a.749.749 0 0 1 .53-.22h6.5a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-9.5a.25.25 0 0 0-.25-.25Zm7 2.25v2.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.5 0v-2.5a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0ZM9 9a1 1 0 1 1-2 0 1 1 0 0 1 2 0Z"></path></svg>Important</p><p>This is a recommended release for all op-challenger operators. It fixes <code>list-games</code> against factories containing super permissioned games, tightens transaction decoding in the bundled kona-host, and updates the container base image to clear a reported CVE.</p>
</div>
<h2>What's Changed</h2>
<h3>Bug fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>list-games</code> no longer aborts against a factory containing both standard and super permissioned games. Super permissioned games from the simplified contract do not expose <code>claimDataLen</code>, so the claim count query is now skipped for type-5 games and reported as zero (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5404788910" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22841" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22841/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22841">#22841</a>)</li>
<li>The bundled kona-host now rejects bare RLP bodies for Deposit and PostExec transactions. Both are EIP-2718 typed transactions with no untyped wire form, so a missing <code>0x7E</code> or <code>0x7D</code> type byte could previously slip past derivation's leading-byte transaction gates (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5347235829" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22778" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22778/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22778">#22778</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Security</h3>
<ul>
<li>The container image now ships zlib 1.3.2-r7, clearing <code>CVE-2026-85091</code></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full Changelog</strong>: <a class="commit-link" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/compare/op-challenger/v1.9.5...op-challenger/v1.9.6"><tt>op-challenger/v1.9.5...op-challenger/v1.9.6</tt></a></p>
<p><strong>🚢 Docker Image:</strong></p>
<ul>

</ul>




</content>

    <title>op-supernode v1.0.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Overview</h2>
<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-note"><p class="markdown-alert-title"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-info mr-2" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 8a8 8 0 1 1 16 0A8 8 0 0 1 0 8Zm8-6.5a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 0 13 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 0-13ZM6.5 7.75A.75.75 0 0 1 7.25 7h1a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.75h.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-2a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5h.25v-2h-.25a.75.75 0 0 1-.75-.75ZM8 6a1 1 0 1 1 0-2 1 1 0 0 1 0 2Z"></path></svg>Note</p><p>This is a recommended release that includes security updates and one breaking RPC field removal.</p>
</div>
<h2>Breaking changes</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>cross_unsafe_l2</code> removed from <code>optimism_syncStatus</code></strong> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5203553120" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22555" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22555/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22555">#22555</a>). The cross-unsafe head byte-for-byte mirrored the unsafe head and is gone from the RPC response and from <code>eth.SyncStatus</code>. Dashboards, alerts, and tooling reading <code>cross_unsafe_l2</code> must switch to <code>unsafe_l2</code>; Go JSON clients tolerate the absent field. The message-safety level named <code>cross-unsafe</code> is a separate concept and is unchanged.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Chain Configuration</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>New World Chain Karst activation times</strong> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5217306343" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22624" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22624/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22624">#22624</a>). The embedded superchain registry gains:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>sepolia/worldchain</code> — <code>karst_time = 1788868800</code> (Tue 8 Sep 2026 12:00:00 UTC)</li>
<li><code>mainnet/worldchain</code> — <code>karst_time = 1789992000</code> (Mon 21 Sep 2026 12:00:00 UTC)</li>
</ul>
<p>An op-supernode managing World Chain from the embedded registry on an earlier release will not activate Karst and will diverge from the chain. No other chain's activation times change in this release.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Other changes</h2>
<h3>Security</h3>
<ul>
<li>Security updates cover the Go 1.26.6 toolchain, <code>golang.org/x/crypto</code> v0.56.0, <code>golang.org/x/mod</code> v0.40.0, and the Pion STUN/DTLS dependency transition, including the op-geth bump that moves its NAT/STUN path to Pion v3 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5148959114" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22424" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22424/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22424">#22424</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5332928057" data-permission-text="Title     <content type="html"><h2>Overview</h2>
<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-note"><p class="markdown-alert-title"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-info mr-2" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 8a8 8 0 1 1 16 0A8 8 0 0 1 0 8Zm8-6.5a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 0 13 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 0-13ZM6.5 7.75A.75.75 0 0 1 7.25 7h1a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.75h.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-2a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5h.25v-2h-.25a.75.75 0 0 1-.75-.75ZM8 6a1 1 0 1 1 0-2 1 1 0 0 1 0 2Z"></path></svg>Note</p><p>This is a recommended release for op-reth operators. It contains routine observability improvements.</p>
</div>
<h2>Other changes</h2>
<h3>Observability</h3>
<ul>
<li>New <code>reth_chain_head_basefee</code>, <code>reth_chain_head_gas_used</code>, and <code>reth_chain_head_blob_gas_used</code> gauges, together with gas-used and blob-gas-used histograms, restore visibility equivalent to op-geth's canonical-head fee and gas metrics. These series begin updating once the node follows the chain through the Engine API and do not advance during backfill (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5208332711" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22587" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22587/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22587">#22587</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full Changelog</strong>: <a class="commit-link" href="https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/compare/op-reth/v2.4.3...op-reth/v2.4.4"><tt>op-reth/v2.4.3...op-reth/v2.4.4</tt></a></p>
